 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Alexander Volkanovski relishes the gag — "Old Van Volk.''
 The accompanying outfit includes a cardigan sweater, a Peaky Blinders cap, and reading glasses. Maybe with a strong enough prescription to see into the not-so-distant future.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Even when he's wearing UFC fighting shorts, Volkanovski will invite the same questions before he takes on Movsar Evloev in a featherweight title fight during the main event at UFC 333 .
 Is Volkanovski, at 38, getting to old to reign as the UFC's featherweight champ ?
 Youth has arrived.
 His next opponent, the Russian-born Movsar Evloev, is getting his first UFC title fight at 32.
 This will be Volkanovski's 12th UFC title fight, but the talk of dominance feels mostly historical. In his last two bouts, he beat Diego Lopes by unanimous decision in solid but unspectacular fashion.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Prior to those bouts, Volkanovski lost three of four fights – by knockout against Ilia Topuria and by knockout and decision to Islam Makhachev.
 It might feel like old news. Or increasingly, it might feel like Volkanovski is simply getting old, with something to prove.
 USA TODAY Sports has everything you need to enjoy UFC 333, including updates, highlights and analysis:
 UFC 333: Time, PPV, streaming for Volkanovski vs. Evloev
 The highly anticipated fight between Alexander Volkanovski and Movsar Evloev will take place on Saturday, Oct. 24 and can be streamed on Paramount+.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Date: Saturday, Oct. 24
 Location: Etihad Arena (Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates)
 Early Prelims start time : 10 a.m. ET
 Early Prelims card stream: Paramount+ 
 Prelims card start time: 12 p.m. ET
 Prelims card stream: Paramount+ 
 Main card start time : 2 p.m. ET on Paramount+ 
 Catch UFC action now all fights on Paramount+ 
 UFC 333: Volkanovski vs. Evloev card predictions
 MMA Junkie : Yan wins
 T.J. Dillashaw for MMA Junkie states, "I am leaning towards Yan. Tough fight. It really is. I think he had all the answers, and that confidence builds. He's had some losses, but those losses were (weird). His losses are minuscule losses, and then that last fight, I think just builds so much confidence that he has what it takes. The answer for Merab, the cardio for Merab. I'm leaning towards Yan, but I think it's going to be a banger of a fight again. Merab is never going to stop and you have to beat the bricks off him to win."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement CBS Sports: Alexander Volkanovski moneyline (-110)
 Brent Brookhouse writes, "This is another fight where it's likely the fighters see the scorecards, but at -275 to go the distance, the odds are too long for the column. Evloev has tremendous wrestling and Volkanovski is 38, which both would usually be checks in the challenger's favor. However, Volkanovski has good takedown defense and isn't likely to be taken down and held there, and he's been somewhat ageless in a division where age usually catches up to fighters quickly. I don't think it's a good thing that Evloev has only fought once since December 2024, and while he could grind out an ugly win if his wrestling gets going, I simply think Volkanovski is too well-rounded, crafty and used to fighting at this level to pick against him."
 Bleacher Report : Evloev by unanimous decision
 Adam Kramer writes, "Volkanovski recovered nicely after back-to-back losses with two wins, albeit both coming over Diego Lopes. Still, he's 38 years old and likely to be pushed at a frantic pace unless he can end this fight early.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "This one doesn't have to be all that complicated. If they stay standing, Volk wins. If Evloev makes it ugly, he likely does enough to win by decision. I believe he'll do that, even if Volkanovski threatens throughout. What a fun matchup."
